name: MCP 集群体检
description: What died, what silently grew, what carries risk in your MCP server fleet.
description_zh: 排查 MCP 服务器集群：哪些已经起不来、哪些升级后偷偷变胖多吃了上下文、哪些配置带风险。录制一次基线，之后每次体检都能看出变化。
description_en: Health, drift and configuration risk for an MCP server fleet: dead servers, silently grown tool lists, and unsafe config flags. Record a baseline once, then see what changed.
examples_zh: 我的 MCP 服务器有没有已经不工作的
最近升级之后 agent 变慢了，是不是哪个服务器变胖了
检查一下我的 MCP 配置有没有安全问题
examples_en: Are any of my MCP servers dead?
The agent got slower after upgrades — did a server silently grow?
Check my MCP config for security problems
